findings.claim: Trace size of a real audit is an unlisted risk that could stop the plan working in practice. Each chat span carries the whole conversation so far in gen_ai.input.messages, and the root span carries pydantic_ai.all_messages, so the payload grows with the square of the run length. From the five real transcripts in the scratchpad (30 to 83 requests, 0.6 to 1.2 MB each), a real audit would send about 11 to 43 MB of span attributes to Langfuse, with single spans near 1 MB. If Langfuse's OTLP endpoint rejects or truncates requests or attributes of that size, real audits lose their traces. Because a failed export never fails the run (by design), nobody would notice. The live check in Done when does not say it must be a full-length audit, so a short prompt could pass it while real runs fail. The plan should list this risk and settle it with a spike (see the body), then either confirm the default exporter settings work or choose a fix such as a smaller max_export_batch_size, include_content=False, or dropping the cumulative message attributes.

Trace size: a full-length audit's trace (tens of MB, chat spans near 1 MB) might be rejected or cut by Langfuse. Settled by spike:langfuse-traces/2, and Done when now requires a full-length live audit.
